review_notes: Read the whole target file and the supporting FiniteIntersections.lean API (isUnit_intersectionSubring_iff, mem_contractedIdeal_iff, localization lemma). Looked for duplicated reasoning across the proofs. The only repeated nontrivial block I found is the "nonzero and outside every contracted ideal implies unit" argument. Other repeats (Nonempty ι from a non-all-trivial family, x ≠ 0 from the subtype) are short and I did not report them. The strength of this finding is modest because each copy is only about 4 lines. A third copy of the sub-step (not < 1 together with ≤ 1 gives = 1) is in FiniteIntersections.lean. The proposed lemma has not been compiled.

findings.problem: Two proofs repeat the same argument that a nonzero element of the intersection which is not in any contracted ideal is a unit. Each one applies isUnit_intersectionSubring_iff, then proves val i x = 1 at every place by combining the membership bound `val i x ≤ 1` (from `mem_intersectionSubring_iff`) with `¬ val i x < 1` (via `le_antisymm` and `le_of_not_gt`). In exists_contractedIdeal_of_isMaximal the second fact comes from `hnot i`, i.e. x ∉ contractedIdeal. In isField_intersectionSubring_iff it comes from a `by_contra` on `hlt`, which then feeds a nontriviality contradiction. The same `le_antisymm … (le_of_not_gt …)` step also appears a third time, in the localization proof in FiniteIntersections.lean (`exact le_antisymm hle (le_of_not_gt hnot)`).
findings.proposed_change:
Add a lemma next to `isUnit_intersectionSubring_iff` (or at the top of this file):

theorem isUnit_intersectionSubring_of_forall_notMem_contractedIdeal (x : intersectionSubring val) (hx0 : (x : K) ≠ 0) (h : ∀ i, x ∉ contractedIdeal val i) : IsUnit x

Proof: `(isUnit_intersectionSubring_iff val x).mpr ⟨hx0, fun i => le_antisymm ((mem_intersectionSubring_iff val _).mp x.property i) (le_of_not_gt fun hlt => h i ((mem_contractedIdeal_iff val i x).mpr hlt))⟩`.

A stronger option is the iff `IsUnit x ↔ (x : K) ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i, x ∉ contractedIdeal val i`.

Use 1, in exists_contractedIdeal_of_isMaximal: `have hunit := isUnit_intersectionSubring_of_forall_notMem_contractedIdeal val x hx0 hnot`. This replaces the 4-line anonymous-constructor block. It runs under `[Finite ι] [Nonempty ι]`, but the lemma needs no hypothesis on ι.

Use 2, in isField_intersectionSubring_iff (`htriv : ∀ i, ¬(val i).IsNontrivial`): `exact (isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mp (isUnit_intersectionSubring_of_forall_notMem_contractedIdeal val x hx0 (fun i hxi => htriv i ((val i).isNontrivial_iff_exists_lt_one.mpr ⟨x, hx0, (mem_contractedIdeal_iff val i x).mp hxi⟩))))`. This removes the `refine`/`apply le_of_not_gt`/`intro hlt` chain.

The lemma assumes no rank hypothesis, so it works in both sections. The third copy in FiniteIntersections.lean could be adapted to the same lemma or to a `val_eq_one_of_notMem_contractedIdeal` sub-lemma.
findings.benefit: The unit criterion is stated once, in terms of the contracted-ideal vocabulary the file is built on. Both proofs then only supply their case-specific reason for x ∉ contractedIdeal. This removes the duplicated ≤ 1 versus ¬ < 1 bookkeeping and makes the connection to prime avoidance and the field case easier to read.

evidence.excerpt:
refine ⟨hx0, fun i => le_antisymm
      ((mem_intersectionSubring_iff val _).mp x.property i) ?_⟩
    apply le_of_not_gt

theorem isUnit_intersectionSubring_iff (x : intersectionSubring val) :
    IsUnit x ↔ (x : K) ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i, val i (x : K) = 1
